formulas.ascii: Gamma = sum_ij w_ij t(x_i, y_j) / sum_ij w_ij over directed edges with positive weight to another included row; t = (x - mx)(y - my) for cross-product (edge-weighted means mx, my), (x - y)^2 for squared-difference, |x - y| for absolute-difference. y is the second variable, or x itself when none is given. NaN when the total edge weight is not positive. There is no analytic p-value.
